phase: Phase G - Agronomic Constraint Rules Catalog

quarantined_inputs.reason: UNVALIDATED_EXCLUDED per Phase D QA audit (SoilGrids N > SOC subsoil anomaly); never used in pass/fail logic.
ESA Crop Frequency 10 m validity spans 2021-2025 only; blocked from 2017-2020 historical attribution.

rules.missing_data_behavior: FAIL if in_annual_rotation_scope is false (OLIVE); UNKNOWN if lifecycle missing.
rules.description: Permanent perennial tree crops (OLIVE) cannot be rotated inside an annual crop sequence slot.

rules.missing_data_behavior: UNKNOWN if target season or suitable_planting_seasons missing.
rules.description: Candidate crop must match its biologically valid Guelma planting season (no winter sowing for Processing Tomato; no summer sowing for cereals).

rules.missing_data_behavior: UNKNOWN (never auto-passed) if water availability or system is unknown for strictly irrigated crops; FAIL if rainfed/none.
rules.description: Strict binary gate forbidding strictly irrigated summer/tuber crops (Processing Tomato, Potato) on rainfed/unirrigated fields; requires confirmed water when availability is unknown.

rules.domain: Regional Rainfall Envelope (GPM vs NASA POWER)
rules.missing_data_behavior: UNKNOWN if both GPM and NASA POWER precipitation values are unavailable/null.
rules.description: Checks dual rainfall bounds (GPM conservative vs POWER upper, preserving +132 mm/yr bias spread) against crop rainfed moisture thresholds; flags cross-product straddles and summer rainfall deficits (e.g. rainfed Sunflower).

rules.missing_data_behavior: UNKNOWN if NASA POWER temperature stats are unavailable/null.
rules.description: Flags summer heat >35 C risk on flowering/summer crops and winter/spring frost caution for cold-sensitive winter pulses (Ascochyta/cold-tolerant seed requirement) with coarse macro-cell caveat.

rules.missing_data_behavior: UNKNOWN if SMAP root-zone moisture metrics are missing.
rules.description: Monitors regional 11 km Winter/Spring root-zone wetness; warns when dry rainfed Spring pulses (<0.20 m3/m3) face moisture deficit.

rules.missing_data_behavior: UNKNOWN if clay_0_30cm is null (e.g. urban/water masked pixels or missing archive).
rules.description: Uses SoilGrids 250 m modeled clay % (NOT lab measurement) to warn on heavy clay (>35%) tuber deformation/waterlogging hazard for Potato and Lentil, and narrow tillage windows on >=32% clay.

rules.source: Phase F Audit; CON_01_TEXTURE (Sys et al. 1993); DEM unavailability
rules.missing_data_behavior: Returns UNKNOWN when DEM is UNAVAILABLE_NOT_INTEGRATED for drainage-sensitive crops (Lentil, Chickpea, Potato, Olive) or WARNING for moderate sensitivity on flat clayey plains.
rules.description: Prevents silently passing drainage requirements while SRTM 30 m DEM is absent locally; preserves visual winter puddling check necessity.
Checks SoilGrids modeled 0-30 cm pH against crop tolerances; flags Potato common scab risk >=6.5 pH (WARNING) and biological extremes (FAIL).

rules.missing_data_behavior: UNKNOWN if soc_0_30cm is null (preserving the 100 SoilGrids SOC-NaN pixels explicitly).
rules.description: Flags Bare Fallow and low-residue disturbance on SOC-depleted (<18 g/kg) Guelma soils while recognizing N-fixing/forage conservation fit.

rules.missing_data_behavior: Returns UNKNOWN on irrigated parcels (reservoir/river/well/groundwater) because parcel ECe/ECw salinity is unmeasured locally; notes Barley higher tolerance.
rules.description: Explicitly avoids passing salinity-sensitive crops without an ECe layer on Seybouse irrigated lands.

rules.domain: ESA 10 m Cropland & Multi-Scale Vegetation Guard
rules.missing_data_behavior: UNKNOWN if CropFreq and vegetation snapshots are all missing.
rules.description: Warns if mapped polygon has low cropland detection share (crop_freq < 0.2, possible tree/urban/fallow/water polygon) while never equating coarse Wilaya S2 fallback or CropFreq with crop identity.
Prevents unvalidated diversification hypotheses from silently reading as fully local DSA-verified guidance.

rules.source: CON_14_FARMER_OPS; Phase G Section 8 (null vs [] preservation)
rules.missing_data_behavior: Returns UNKNOWN when equipment_constraints is null ('NOT_PROVIDED') for machinery-specialized crops; PASS when explicitly [] ('EXPLICITLY_CONFIRMED_EMPTY'); WARNING if matching restriction present.
rules.description: Preserves strict separation between omitted/null machinery info and explicitly confirmed empty equipment constraints.

rules.source: CON_14_FARMER_OPS; Phase G Section 8 (null vs [] preservation)
rules.missing_data_behavior: Returns UNKNOWN when forage_value_weight is null ('NOT_PROVIDED'); checks alignment only when explicitly provided (including 0.0).
rules.description: Ensures optional forage requirements are never assumed zero or mandatory silently.
